environment.evidence: Environment requirements on inherited global-mean air and one equatorial CM1 ring. No floater trajectory, measured lunar humidity/LWC, aerial radiative field, viable water cycle or thermal physiology is established.
environment.reading_rule: Water kg per projected organism m² unless leaf area is stated. twilight_energy_assumption.reading_rule: The inherited plant model assumes the1deg diffuse-black spectrum at every twilight angle. calendar_ground_visual_reference.reading_rule: Solved ground point-source diffuse solar illuminance, lux; finite solar disk and Earthlight not integrated here. Calendar stores no ground spectral irradiance for energy conversion.

threshold_example.note: The7W/m² threshold applies only if1% efficiency is valid on the same input spectrum/area at twilight. Full-solar laboratory efficiency is not automatically a twilight or202–1000nm efficiency. This is not a default H2 duty.

photoperiod.plant_reference_limits: LAI5 ground stand, fixed zero-declination geometry, terrestrial C3 model and near/far land temperature traces. near/far PAR darkness is identical because Earthlight is absent from plant.py light inputs. Respiration is not a floater calibration.
